speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, and severe fatigue. To help me understand your condition better, have you noticed any skin rash or stiff neck symptoms recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Have you experienced any muscle pain, sensitivity to light, or abdominal pain since the ice cream consumption? Also, have you had any contact with someone who had chickenpox recently?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Viral Gastroenteritis (likely secondary to foodborne illness from ice cream). Given your pregnancy, please stay hydrated and monitor for signs of dehydration or high fever. If your fever exceeds 100.4°F or you develop severe abdominal pain, seek immediate care.
